notes.title: New FREE game Questinarium has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26478329/86d832eda5d005b881324338104b90af4b76acd5.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi Linea players, Oxy949 is here with some great news![/b]

[h3]My new free game [b]Questinarium[/b], made in collaboration with Dymchick1 has been finally released! Check it out :)[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226070/Questinarium/

Have fun!

notes.title: Fixed Level 6
notes.content:
Hi!

Before the update you could get through "It's not my ship" level without moving your head at all. Now it should be fixed.

Thx: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/kontur10]kontur10[/url] for finding the bug.

Have fun!

notes.title: Linea VR is out!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33019266/b0a460c4219a031927f60af768bf9fc5d4763115.png[/img]

[h1]Hi friends![/h1]

[b]KHB-Soft[/b]'s main dev [b]Oxy949[/b] here with great news!

Remastered VR-version of "[b]Linea, the Game[/b]" is finally available for playing. As I said before it was really fun to remake my old game for VR! And thanks you all for your feedback during beta-test.

Have fun and see you soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144100/Linea_VR

notes.title: Linea VR - Open Beta Testing
notes.content:
Hi!

Linea VR is almost ready for release. Now we need some feedback and suggestions about the game (and bug reports, if they exists). You can help us if you have a VR-helmet.

To opt in [b]BETA-test[/b] of the game use this form: [url=https://khb-soft.ru/main/#three] form link[/url]
[i]Enter "Linea VR Beta Testing" as a message subject[/i]

Have fun!
